description:
The plugin contract between Flex-E-Markets service implementations
        (e.g. trading robots) and their hosts. A host discovers a ServiceProvider
        via ServiceLoader and runs the Service it creates, without compiling
        against the implementation.

        Carries three things: the ServiceProvider/Service interfaces, the
        manifest a service uses to describe itself, and CliBuilder, which turns
        described parameters into the argument array the provider is created
        with. The manifest and the builder are here because both sides must
        agree on them exactly: a host that derived arguments its own way would
        be a second implementation of the contract, differing from the first
        only where it was wrong.

        No host internals and no implementation of any service. Published
        publicly so providers and hosts share one contract without copying
        source; the implementations stay private and are delivered to hosts as
        runtime plugin jars.
